user.title: Add a TV screenshot camera
user.description: Select an LG TV already paired with the built-in LG webOS Smart TV integration. A snapshot camera will expose the visible TV screen to Home Assistant. Captures happen only on image requests, at most once a minute. Some apps and protected content cannot be captured.

data.allow_websocket: Allow screenshot access through the WebSocket API

data_description.allow_websocket: Optional for custom dashboards. Authenticated clients with read access to the selected TV can request its screenshot. Standard camera cards do not need this option.

error.invalid_tv: Select an enabled media player from the built-in LG webOS Smart TV integration.

abort.already_configured: This television already has a screenshot camera.
